title: Application of Massachusetts Electric Company, under the provisions of G.L c. 164, § 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. No. 379, for the approval by the Deparmtent of Public Utilities of an interim change in the power cost charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billing month of June 1985. The interim power cost charge reflects charge in prudently incurred, reasonable costs of fuels and power purchased by the Company.
